title: Japanese Beef Stew
description: A hearty, charred Japanese-inspired beef stew with rich flavors and tender beef.
instructions: 1. Season beef with sesame oil, sugar, and red pepper flakes.
2. In a large Dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sesame oil over medium-high.
3. Sear beef until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes.
4. Remove beef from pot and set aside.
5. Reduce heat to medium and add 2 tbsp of sesame oil.
6. Add charred onions and cook until caramelized, about 5 minutes.
7. Add ginger and cook for 1 minute.
8. Add soy sauce, sake, and mirin to pot.
9. Return beef to pot and bring to a simmer.
10. Cover pot and transfer to oven.
11. Braise beef in oven at 300°F (150°C) for 2 hours.
12. Remove beef from pot and let rest for 10 minutes.
13. Slice beef and return to pot.
14. Stir in green onions and serve.
